integer_encoding: all hash-preimage integers below are unsigned fixed-width big-endian; uint64 for base_seed/x bits and uint32 for repetition/stratum/fold

group_identity.x_bits: 16 lowercase hexadecimal digits of normalized finite binary64 big-endian bits, prefixed f64:
group_identity.x_group_id: literal xg: followed by x_bits, for example xg:f64:3ff0000000000000
group_identity.canonical_group_order: ascending numerical finite x; distinct finite binary64 values have an unambiguous total order after -0 normalization
group_identity.canonical_row_order_inside_group: ascending exact logical row_id UTF-8 bytes; canonical row_id uniqueness is guaranteed by the data adapter

outer_split.fold_count: K is fixed by validation policy before assignment
outer_split.strata: partition canonical group indices into consecutive chunks [s*K,min((s+1)*K,G)); s starts at zero
outer_split.group_rank_preimage: UTF8 outer-group-rank-v1 followed by one NUL byte, uint64(base_seed), uint32(repetition), uint32(stratum), uint64(normalized x bits)
outer_split.group_order_in_stratum: ascending lexicographic 32-byte SHA-256 digest of group_rank_preimage, then ascending normalized x bits
outer_split.fold_priority_preimage: UTF8 outer-fold-priority-v1 followed by one NUL byte, uint64(base_seed), uint32(repetition), uint32(stratum), uint32(fold)
outer_split.fold_priority: ascending lexicographic 32-byte SHA-256 digest of fold_priority_preimage, then ascending fold integer
outer_split.assignment: initialize K cumulative row loads to zero; visit strata and ranked groups in order; within each stratum each fold is eligible at most once; assign the group to the eligible fold minimizing (current cumulative row load, fold-priority rank, fold integer), then add the entire atomic group size
outer_split.y_firewall: neither y values nor a hash/order derived from y occurs in ranking, load balancing, membership or IDs

membership_ledger.bytes: canonical-hash-json-v1 compact UTF-8 JSON array, no trailing line feed
membership_ledger.membership_sha256: SHA-256 of exact membership ledger bytes

training_scope_id.bytes: canonical-hash-json-v1 compact UTF-8 JSON object, no trailing line feed
training_scope_id.scope_id: lowercase SHA-256 of exact training-scope payload bytes; this non-circular ID is computed before LLM calls and is the scope_id used by start-slot-policy-v1

split_id.groups: test membership-ledger entries in canonical group order
split_id.bytes: canonical-hash-json-v1 compact UTF-8 JSON object, no trailing line feed
split_id.split_id: lowercase SHA-256 of exact payload bytes

golden.row_id_rule: group i has exact IDs g{i}-r{j}, j=0..group_sizes[i]-1
